docs.placeable.component: `Placeable` is a MARKER: presence says "this can be set into a slot", absence declines, and
there is no second field to disagree with either answer. It requires `Bounded`, because a
thing set into a slot needs a footprint the slot can seat.
import { node, Bounded, Placeable, placeable } from "game-kit"
placeable(node("mark"))       // false — no atom, no seat
What reads the marker is the move machinery: a slot layout seats only placeables, and `planMove`
refuses to seat what never claimed it could sit. There is no `canPlace: false` anywhere — the
capability IS the field, which is why a marker atom has none.
docs.placeable.marker: Two identical tokens, one difference a renderer cannot show: the left one is `Placeable`, the
right one is not. Nothing on the glass differs — the marker draws nothing — and that is the
lesson: what changes is the ANSWER the move machinery gets when a slot asks whether it may seat
this. Open the Node tree panel to see the capability on the left token.
